verdicts.reading: Political risk from uneven eurozone fiscal positions materially returns to the eurozone in 2010.
verdicts.mainstream_test: A eurozone sovereign fiscal/political crisis with documented effect occurred in calendar 2010.
verdicts.reason: Greece took a EUR110bn bailout with austerity and mass protests in May 2010, the EFSF was created, and Ireland took a EUR67.5bn bailout in November 2010.

evidence.title: European debt crisis
evidence.shows: Greece EUR110bn loan May 2010, EFSF created 2010, Ireland EUR67.5bn bailout 29 Nov 2010.

evidence.title: Dodd-Frank Act
evidence.shows: Signed 21 July 2010; passed largely along party lines, Senate 60-39.

evidence.title: 2010 United States elections
evidence.shows: Republicans won the House in the 2010 midterms.
